note: Files: S3 r4/modal_t3-01/t3/T3.jsonl (fetched to runs/theory-tests/s3/T3.jsonl; 500 rows, one per problem_index, so the keep-first rule never fires) and studies/rlneurons/results/rln4/t1_t2_items-01/per_problem.json (500 entries, t1_right int). v3 recomputed with rln4_lib.grade_v3(gold, text), the function rln4_grader_v3.py calls; empty text / no extraction gives 0, cap hits keep their v3 score. Self-opened = actual newline + 'Okay' within text[:60] (the JSON '\\nOkay' read as the newline the parenthesis describes; plain texts typically start '.\n\nOkay, ...', so this matches). Markers 'Wait'/'Hmm' case-sensitive substrings anywhere in text (so 'Hmmm', 'Waiting' also count). alt_measured: self-opened read as 'Okay' anywhere in the first 60 characters, no newline required. Empty-text rows (21) are not self-opened and have no markers, so they are excluded from L. B uses the stored t1_right (grader v3 on S3 T1, cue, a different sample), not a regrade. If L is empty the script prints not_computable (recipe: report nothing); refuted_by is null so refuted_by_met is always false.

File: S3 T3.jsonl as in k=4 (one row per problem). v3 recomputed with rln4_lib.grade_v3; empty extraction 0; cap hits kept. Self-opened rows (newline+'Okay' in text[:60]) dropped; M = remaining rows containing case-sensitive 'Wait' or 'Hmm' anywhere, N = all other remaining rows, which includes the 21 empty-text rows (score 0) and cap hits; that pulls N's mean down. alt_measured: self-opened read as 'Okay' anywhere in text[:60]. If M or N is empty the script prints not_computable (report nothing).
